question: Can sparse but registered metric source geometry calibrate an interpretable, factor-specific ACCEPT-or-UNKNOWN gate for foundation-geometry predictions that transfers to unseen parents and expands task-independent depth, support and physical-boundary supervision without treating teacher output as truth?
principle: Teacher predictions may extend evidence coverage only after parent-disjoint calibration against hidden source geometry. Agreement and confidence are gate features, not truth or sigma labels; unsupported regions remain UNKNOWN.

route_relation.c0_reuse: Reuse only teacher-output-before-truth-join, independent-truth and UNKNOWN invariants. C0 teacher identities, task metrics and complementarity terminal are not reused.

data_partitions.identity_basis: Existing TRAIN-only source capability and registration receipts; no Development, Confirmation or task outcome is admitted.
A successor must freeze exact GATE_FIT, THRESHOLD_CALIBRATION and HELD_OUT_CANARY parents plus deterministic hidden-truth masks before any teacher output.

source_contract.candidate_parent_pool: Existing disclosed ARKitScenes B1 TRAIN 16-parent pool only; no Development or Confirmation identity.
source_contract.cross_factor_role_policy: Factor gates are independent. If an implementation shares learned parameters, thresholds or truth-derived features across factors, the strict joint role assignment must be used and no parent may be FIT for one shared component while CANARY for another.

source_input_and_truth_roles.observed_anchor: Only explicitly declared RGB/K/pose and partial source depth outside the hidden target support may enter the teacher or gate.
source_input_and_truth_roles.hidden_evaluation_truth: Registered metric source geometry within pre-frozen withheld pixels or views; inaccessible to teacher, gate fitting and threshold selection for HELD_OUT_CANARY.
source_input_and_truth_roles.invalid_or_unsupported: UNKNOWN; never negative, free, non-boundary or support=false.

source_contract.current_pose_timestamp_gap: DCA explicit_timestamp_materialized and pose_transform_materialized are both zero. A source adapter must materialize and bind them before pose-conditioned execution.

factor_only_reader.reason: Existing B1 targets contain task fields that are forbidden inputs and supervision for AG-ST.

withholding_and_leakage_contract.mask_generation: Deterministic masks and strata are generated, serialized and hashed before teacher inference.
withholding_and_leakage_contract.calibration_may_view_hidden_truth: Only THRESHOLD_CALIBRATION may use its own hidden residuals to choose one frozen threshold per factor. HELD_OUT_CANARY truth remains unavailable until all thresholds and transforms are signed.

factor_truth_contract.depth: Metric depth residual against valid hidden registered geometry.
factor_truth_contract.normal: Dense surface normal is a derivation and gate diagnostic only; it is not a current F1 supervision field.
factor_truth_contract.support: Task-independent gravity-relative surface support derived only from valid hidden registered geometry using a separately frozen deterministic transform.
factor_truth_contract.boundary: Task-independent physical surface discontinuity, normal discontinuity, connected-surface termination, support/non-support geometric transition or gravity-relative step derived from hidden registered geometry.
factor_truth_contract.boundary_forbidden_definition: Any edge defined by whether the current body profile or reducer changes clearance, occupancy or final state.
factor_truth_contract.uncertainty: Teacher confidence, disagreement and geometric residuals supervise only selective admission features. R2 sigma remains learned later from valid factor residuals and a proper score.

teacher_stages.question: Does one source-conditioned geometry model produce a transferable selective risk-coverage curve?
At matched per-factor risk, how much additional held-out-parent coverage is gained by adding a pose-conditioned DA3 prediction and disagreement features?

label_status_contract.A_SOURCE_TRUTH: Valid source-native or registered metric geometry under its own provenance and mask.
label_status_contract.B_R0_GATE_ACCEPTED_PSEUDO_CANDIDATE: Teacher-derived value accepted by the frozen R0 gate. It remains pseudo and has no F1 supervision authority.
label_status_contract.C_R0_UNACCEPTED_PSEUDO_CANDIDATE: Teacher output available for diagnostics or mining only.
label_status_contract.D_UNKNOWN: Unsupported, invalid, low-confidence, conflicting or out-of-contract evidence.

evaluation_contract.grain: Compute pixel or region residuals within capture parent first, then parent-macro. Frames and pixels are not independent evidence.
evaluation_contract.coverage_denominator: Valid hidden source truth for the declared factor and stratum. UNKNOWN is not an error-free omission; it lowers selective coverage.
evaluation_contract.selective_risk: Mean declared factor loss among ACCEPT values, computed within parent and then parent-macro.
evaluation_contract.conformal_or_crc_policy: May be added only in a new version after the base score shows held-out-parent error ordering and calibration transfer. It cannot rescue an unstable score.

future_execution_gate_design.threshold_freeze_timing: Every factor-specific error tolerance, risk ceiling, minimum denominator, minimum useful coverage and Stage 0B incremental gain must be frozen in the next implementation/execution lock before first teacher output.
future_execution_gate_design.calibration_rule: Select at most one threshold per factor using THRESHOLD_CALIBRATION parents to meet the pre-frozen risk ceiling while maximizing coverage; no canary tuning.
future_execution_gate_design.held_out_rule: The same threshold must meet the pre-frozen parent-macro upper risk bound and minimum useful coverage in every required critical stratum on HELD_OUT_CANARY.
future_execution_gate_design.baseline_rule: The full gate must improve or dominate declared source-only, unfiltered-teacher and confidence-only baselines without a factor-specific or critical-stratum reversal.
future_execution_gate_design.stage_0b_rule: Stage 0B is not part of this execution version. A new pre-outcome version must freeze an unconsumed canary and a minimum matched-risk incremental coverage before DA3 output; otherwise the second teacher cannot receive a primary claim.

constraints.description: This lock may create only protocol, official-source audit and current-route facts; it may not download or run teachers, open new source payload, materialize labels or train a student.

Hidden source truth and its deterministic factor derivatives are inaccessible to teacher inference, gate fitting outside declared FIT/calibration roles and pre-join scoring; teacher outputs must precede truth join.
Support and boundary definitions use only physical geometry, gravity, registration and validity; final clearance, occupancy, body profile and reducer output cannot define or supervise them.
Teacher output, confidence, disagreement and model consensus retain pseudo provenance and cannot be renamed source truth or uncertainty truth; rejection remains UNKNOWN.
Future evaluation is parent-macro and factor-specific with critical-stratum risk-coverage curves; global pixel agreement, aggregate loss or an easy-region majority cannot rescue a failed factor.

AG-ST R0 is a parallel WILD_LAB diagnostic and neither modifies nor satisfies the current F1 supervision contract. Any later use of accepted pseudo-labels requires a new pre-outcome source-label contract version.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Freeze an exact source adapter, factor-specific parent roles, hidden-truth masks, one MapAnything artifact and factor risk ceilings; produce all outputs before truth join, fit an interpretable gate on GATE_FIT, select thresholds only on THRESHOLD_CALIBRATION and evaluate unchanged risk-coverage on HELD_OUT_CANARY. DA3 is deferred to a new pre-outcome version with an unconsumed canary.
experiment_design.resource_budget: This lock is static documentation only. The next lock must separately cap downloads, GPU memory/time, number of views, output bytes and retries; absent values mean no execution authority.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop before any teacher output until exact source/teacher/checkpoint/license/transform/role/mask/risk identities are frozen. During future execution, stop on leakage, undefined factor denominators, receipt mismatch, failed source validity or the first factor-specific selective-risk gate failure.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Registered metric geometry provides sparse local residual evidence, while source-conditioned foundation geometry may densify missing regions. A reject option can be learned from anchor residual, reprojection, geometric consistency and teacher confidence without declaring the teacher globally correct.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Evaluates a parent-disjoint ACCEPT-or-UNKNOWN admission function against hidden source geometry instead of treating a single teacher, ensemble mean or confidence map as truth.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines per factor and critical stratum whether pseudo-supervision can expand usable coverage at a bounded held-out-parent error, and whether a second teacher adds meaningful matched-risk coverage.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Stage 0A MapAnything single-teacher risk-coverage with factor-specific parent-disjoint roles and leak-proof source withholding. Any Stage 0B DA3 incremental comparison requires a new pre-outcome protocol and unconsumed canary.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Per-factor parent-macro selective risk-coverage, held-out risk at a calibration-only threshold, minimum useful critical-stratum coverage, error-order transfer and Stage 0B matched-risk coverage gain.
hypotheses.falsifier: Hidden-truth leakage, unstable score-error ordering, held-out risk above the pre-frozen ceiling, insufficient or single-parent critical-stratum coverage, factor reversal, or no pre-frozen Stage 0B incremental coverage gain.
hypotheses.resource_budget: No network, model download, GPU inference, source materialization or training in this lock. A successor must freeze a bounded host-only offline budget.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject only the failed factor, gate score, teacher increment, implementation or evidence version named by the first failure; never lower the risk ceiling, merge factors or use reducer/task output to rescue it.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It directly tests the supervision bottleneck with the smallest single-teacher experiment while preserving source truth, UNKNOWN and the current F1 authority boundary.

unique_successor.scope: Freeze exact source parent roles, RGB/K/pose/depth adapter and coordinate receipts, deterministic hidden-truth masks and factor transforms, exact MapAnything revision/checkpoint/license/dependencies, interpretable gate form, factor-specific risk ceilings, minimum denominators, minimum useful coverage, resource budget, evaluator implementation hashes and mutation tests. Do not run teacher inference, join truth, materialize pseudo-labels or train a student.

claim_ceiling: AG-ST R0 freezes only a source-grounded selective-labelability question, epistemic classes, two-stage evaluation design, leakage firewall, parent/factor risk-coverage semantics and honest blockers. It does not execute a teacher, prove labelability, create labels, calibrate R2 uncertainty, amend or satisfy F1, train a model, establish task benefit, deploy, change the default App or support product or safety claims.
